reference_role: The newly generated knight is a style reference only. Each requested asset is a separate generation.

prompts.knight: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single original RPG Maker-style 16-bit pixel-art knight sprite, full-body isolated on true transparent background. Start a NEW design from scratch. Actual output canvas requested: 768x1536, exactly 1:2 aspect ratio; intended logical artwork is 48x96 game pixels enlarged 16 times. Draw coarse intentional square pixel clusters with zero smoothing, no gradients, no texture noise or dithering. Character design: very cute but heroic SD chibi, genuinely TWO HEADS TALL from helmet to boots, huge round head occupying nearly half the visible height, short torso and stubby legs. Open silver helmet with a short red plume, clearly visible warm face, two large separated dark eyes each with a tiny white highlight, simple eyebrows and a small mouth; readable face, not a featureless visor. Shining silver and blue-gray plate armor with only a few broad material ramps, red cape and red tabard, gold buckle, one gloved hand holding a short sword downward beside the body, other hand visibly holding a compact red kite shield. Keep hand-to-prop contact obvious. Three-quarter top-down field-game projection, front facing slightly toward viewer's left; upper-left light, dark navy-purple selective one-game-pixel outline, restrained warm gold accents. Limited cohesive palette: dark #10101c, blue steel #35465f #7896aa #aec4ca #e1ebdf, red #641c37 #952d48 #c3484c, gold #9e7240 #edce7b, skin #c17d71 #e3ad8c #f8d4ab, ivory #faedd7. Large organized clusters designed to remain legible at 48x96. Entire character including sword and plume fits inside the canvas with 4 logical pixels of transparent margin, feet on a common y=92 baseline, no cast shadow (it will be a separate layer). Do not make realistic adult proportions, long limbs, intricate filigree, a mockup, a rendered 3D figure, text, frames, a contact sheet, a background, or extra characters.
prompts.princess: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE NEW INDEPENDENT sprite, not an edit of the knight or a lineup. True transparent background, full subject in frame, no text, border, checkerboard, ground, glow, translucent halo, texture noise, dithering, gradients, 3D rendering or realistic anatomy. Every edge should be crisp stepped squares. Create an original blonde PRINCESS, cute two-head-tall SD character. Desired 1:2 canvas 768x1536 representing 48x96 logical game pixels enlarged16x. Oversized round face occupying almost half the visible body height, clearly separated blue eyes with highlights, small smiling mouth, blonde hair in two broad organized side locks, compact gold crown with ONE red jewel. White and ivory dress with a broad crimson central panel, restrained gold hem, short arms and little visible hands at the sides, two tiny shoes visible under skirt. Keep crown, eyes, fingers, bodice and hem as broad clear clusters that will remain legible at 48x96. Facing front slightly toward viewer left, upper-left light. Whole sprite fits 4 logical pixel margins, feet at y92. Same face scale and outline thickness as the reference; do not use adult or tall doll proportions. No sword or shield. Separate asset, no cast shadow.
